microsoft-wordmark.svg.sourceNote: Wikimedia Commons file, described there as the Microsoft logo from 1987 to 2012, extracted from Microsoft's 2007 Local Software Economy Initiative Annual Report. Public-domain text logo on that page. This is not the 2012 four-square mark.
microsoft-wordmark.svg.whyThisFile: The portfolio Microsoft spans run from the late 1990s through March 2015. This wordmark was the company mark for all of that except the last part of the body-tracking bar, which continues after the 2012 change. The later symbol is not used.

amazon-wordmark.svg.sourceNote: Wikimedia Commons file, described there as the corporate logo launched on 25 January 2000 and retired in 2012. Public-domain text logo on that page. This is not the 2012 smile redraw or the 2024 redraw.
amazon-wordmark.svg.whyThisFile: The portfolio Amazon employer row is March 2007 – April 2008, inside the years this wordmark was the company mark. The book-page service and the Kindle e-paper API both use it. A separate Kindle product mark from 2007 was not verified, so it is not drawn.

namesOnly.zenith: Zenith Image Systems. A verified logo for that division, as distinct from the consumer television mark, was not found.
namesOnly.hughes: The portfolio names Hughes and does not say which Hughes company. A historical aircraft or network mark would pick a company the page does not establish.
namesOnly.new-resolutions: No verified logo for New Resolutions.
namesOnly.online-resources: No verified logo for Online Resources from the portfolio years.
namesOnly.ace: No verified logo for AC&E Ltd.
namesOnly.lcc: No verified logo for LCC International.
namesOnly.spc: No verified logo. The short name is the initials of Software Productivity Consortium, the name in the portfolio.
namesOnly.nada: The portfolio names the National Automobile Dealers Association. A mark from the project months was not verified, so the current association logo is not used.
namesOnly.daqri: No verified DAQRI logo file with a traceable source was bundled.
namesOnly.margrave: No verified logo for Margrave Technologies.
namesOnly.magic-leap: A Magic Leap file on Wikimedia Commons was taken from the company site in 2024. That does not establish the mark used from 2017 to 2020, so the name is set in type.
namesOnly.niantic: No company wordmark from 2020–2022 was verified. The Ingress product symbol is a different product and is not used.
namesOnly.quintar: No verified Quintar logo was found.
namesOnly.forza-kinect-azure-kindle: Forza, Kinect, Azure, and Kindle product marks from the project years were not verified. Those bars use the employer wordmark from the years above, not a later product symbol.
